public_health_question.v: What characterized a cluster of HIV infections among young persons in a rural Mississippi town, and what risk factors and care barriers were present?

ev.q: This report summarizes the investigation of this cluster and underscores the need for HIV prevention and treatment in rural areas.
Cluster of HIV-Infected Adolescents and Young Adults --- Mississippi, 1999

a case-control analysis was performed to assess risk factors for infection
